test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The ‘Urban Self Employment Programme’ and the ‘Urban Wage Employment Programme’ are the two special components of which poverty alleviation programme of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swarna Jayanti Shahari Rozgar Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 'Urban Self Employment Programme' and the 'Urban Wage Employment Programme' are integral components of the Swarna Jayanti Shahari Rozgar Yojana (SJSRY).
 
• This programme was initiated by the Government of India to provide employment to the urban unemployed and underemployed through the encouragement of setting up self-employment ventures or provision of wage employment.
 
• This scheme aims to address urban poverty by enabling the community and the poor to gain access to income-generating opportunities.
 
• SJSRY encompasses skill training and financial support to facilitate beneficiaries in starting their ventures or finding suitable employment.
